Our Canadian operation, Canaccord Genuity Corp., is seeking a curious hands-on Jr Software Developer with preferred experience in .Net (C#), Python, Azure, Azure Devops, and SQL to join our Application and Integrations team in the Wealth Management Group. The ideal candidate would be pursing a degree in computer science or related field. You communicate clearly, learn quickly, and take ownership of small end-to-end tasks with guidance. This is a hybrid role with alternating days in the office. Hours for this role range from 7:00 am - 3:00 pm, and 8:00 am - 4:00 pm. Job Requirements & Qualifications Responsibilities: • Build AI-based automations and platforms to streamline workflows across finance, risk, compliance, and operations. • Accelerate internal automation projects (e.g., contract approval workflows, payroll exception handling, invoice allocations). • Prototype, evaluate, and test AI tools (e.g., Claude Code) and help integrate them into developer workflows. • Stay current on and recommend improvements in cloud tooling, AI/automation platforms, developer productivity, code scanning/security tooling. • Develop and maintain backend services and APIs. • Contribute to front-end features in Angular, integrating with backend APIs and authentication. • Support, debug, and modernize legacy applications; participate in migrations to the latest .NET/Angular and Azure services. • Write clean, maintainable code with unit/integration tests; participate in code reviews and use Git-based workflows. • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines; respond to code scanning results and adopt secure coding practices. • Work with Azure services for hosting, storage, identity, and monitoring. • Collaborate with product, operations, and compliance partners; break down requirements, document simple designs, and deliver increments in an agile process Job Requirements Key Qualifications: • Pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field; or equivalent experience. • 0-2 years of hands-on programming experience in either: • C#/.NET (ASP.NET Core, basic Web APIs), or • Python (FastAPI/Flask, basic scripting/automation). • Familiarity with: • Core CS concepts (OOP, data structures, algorithms). • REST/HTTP, JSON, serialization. • Git, branching, pull requests, code reviews. • Writing and running unit tests (xUnit or pytest). • Basic SQL (SELECTs, joins) and data access patterns (EF Core or SQLAlchemy). • Comfort reading existing code, debugging, adding logs/metrics, and writing clear documentation. Strong communication skills and a willingness to learn quickly in a fast-paced environment. • Preferred Qualifications: • Angular (TypeScript): components, services, routing, forms, basic RxJS. • Azure cloud: Functions, App Service, Storage (Queues/Blobs/Tables), Key Vault, Application Insights, Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions. • AI/automation: familiarity with LLMs and developer AI tools (e.g., Claude, OpenAI), prompt design, data pipelines, SDK/API integration. • Secure coding and compliance awareness (static analysis, code scanning, secrets management, auth flows like OAuth/OpenID Connect). • Messaging/async processing patterns (queues, pub/sub) and event-driven design. • Exposure to financial systems or back-office operations. • Secure coding and compliance awareness (static analysis, code scanning, secrets management, auth flows like OAuth/OpenID Connect). • Messaging/async processing patterns (queues, pub/sub) and event-driven design.
